title: My Quarto site
text:
Quarto
It is a next-generation tool for authoring documents that combines Markdown with code execution in languages like R, Python, and Julia. It is designed for producing high-quality outputs in various formats like HTML and PDF.
This is a Quarto website.
To learn more about Quarto websites visit https://quarto.org/docs/websites.






Quarto is an open source tools for scientific and technical publishing.





Markdown
Markdown is a plain text format that is designed to be easy to write, and, even more importantly, easy to read.

title: My 10-Week DevOps Learning Plan
text:
This is my 10-week plan for the upcoming SCRUM sprints, focusing on Python programming, bash scripting, and DevOps skills development.



Complete Python MOOC 2024 exercises
Learn bash scripting
Develop DevOps skills, particularly in pipelines
Balance learning with work and personal commitments


“The only way to learn a new programming language is by writing programs in it.” - Dennis Ritchie




Here’s a simple Python function that prints “Hello, World!”:
def hello_world():
    """Print a greeting to the world."""
    print("Hello, World!")

hello_world()

Milestone 1: Complete Python MOOC Parts 3-7 by March 23, 2025
Milestone 2: Implement a fully functional CI/CD pipeline by April 20, 2025
Milestone 3: Complete Advanced Python Course and integrate all skills in a final project by June 1, 2025
